text:
maria gonzalez: Hey all — brand new M3 MBP, running Ventura. Went through the Kandji/Okta flow but it hangs at 'Applying configuration' and then I get a FileVault prompt asking for a local admin password I don't have. I also need sudo to install a few CLI tools and to add my SSH key to GitHub. Who should I ping for a temp admin or to check the device assignment?

tom - IT: Welcome @maria gonzalez! Don’t panic. Pinging @it-help-bot. Before we create anything, can you paste the exact message on the FileVault prompt or a screenshot? If it says "Waiting for activation" try connecting to office/corp wifi and reboot first.

it-help-bot: Thanks @tom. Opening ticket INC-2026-21789 for Maria. Maria, please run and paste the output of: `profiles status -type enrollment` and `system_profiler SPHardwareDataType | grep 'Serial'` so we have the device serial.

maria gonzalez: Output snip: `MDM enrollment: No enrolled MDM` and `Serial Number: C02GX0R12345`. Kandji dashboard shows device assigned to me though. Screenshot: <img_2026-03-23.png>

julia - SRE: If it's listed in Kandji, sometimes the assignment takes a minute to propagate. If you need to install Homebrew or docker quickly, we can grant a short-lived temp admin via JumpCloud. @tom can you approve a 2-hour window?

tom - IT: Approved. @maria gonzalez I won't post creds in channel — DMing you the temp admin username. Once you log in with that, MDM should complete and FileVault can start escrow.

maria gonzalez: Got the DM creds, logged in. Kandji finished applying and FileVault kicked off encryption. Thanks!! Quick follow-up: what's the recommended path to add my SSH pubkey to the org?

dev-platform-bot: Add your public key to GitHub (Settings → SSH and GPG keys) for your personal account, then submit the same public key through our secure onboarding form: https://redwood.company/secrets/ssh-upload (requires SSO). We will sync it to internal repos if needed.

oliver - security: FYI — do not reuse a private key you use elsewhere for CI. If you need a deploy key, open a separate request. For developer laptop access, the standard SSH keypair is fine.

maria gonzalez: Done — pushed pubkey to GitHub and submitted via the form. Encryption is 6% done and Kandji shows FileVault escrow success. All good so far :rocket:

it-help-bot: Marking INC-2026-21789 resolved; reopen if anything else pops up.

julia - SRE: Welcome aboard @maria gonzalez — if you want, post a quick intro in #general and we’ll ferry you some stickers :)

maria gonzalez: Will do! Thanks everyone :heart:
